title: Semantic Dashes
summary: Saved living topic views over Results are implemented as reference-only Semantic Dashes with Review-mode refresh, explicit overrides, semantic reopening, Vault persistence and public MCP support.
decisions: A Dash stores Result references instead of copying Result knowledge.
Review mode is the active MVP; Automatic mode is disabled.
Deleting a Dash must not delete its Results.
next: Verify behaviour on the stable production deployment separately; keep authenticated private-Vault access in its own future storage/auth slice.

title: Living Product Board
summary: DashGPT dogfoods its own Result and Semantic Dash model: product topics become trackable Results and the stable product board replaces the separately maintained textual status page.
decisions: Reuse the existing dashgpt-product Semantic Dash instead of introducing a ProductBoard entity.
The public board is repository-backed and reconstructable without browser localStorage.
Refresh is Review-only and must never silently mutate product decisions.
next: Review and merge PR #21; after merge, verify the stable production deployment separately before advancing beyond merged.
